description: This file defines an interface (IGraphAnalyzer) for graph analysis components within the Graphing::Analyzer namespace, including virtual methods for performing analysis, retrieving captions, and messages.

classes.name: IGraphAnalyzer
classes.description: An interface for graph analysis operations, including methods to check if analysis can be performed, perform analysis, and retrieve related messages and captions.

methods.name: CanFunctionAnalysisBePerformed
methods.description: Checks if function analysis can be performed and indicates if a variable is not X.

methods.name: PerformFunctionAnalysis
methods.description: Performs the specified type of function analysis.

methods.name: GetAnalysisTypeCaption
methods.description: Retrieves a caption for the specified analysis type.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message related to the graph analysis.
